title: Enable queue-driven Work execution without manual handoff

payload.goal: Make Work-equivalent local execution receive royal-queue tasks directly so the user does not need to click ChatGPT Work handoff or copy results back.
requirements: Inspect current royal-queue watcher/bridge/router and existing work actor support.
Implement or complete a queue-driven work adapter that executes safe local file/PowerShell/Python/Git tasks directly from assigned_to=work jobs.
Do not depend on ChatGPT Work UI handoff for normal local execution.
Preserve UUID idempotency, canonical todo->in_progress->done|failed|waiting_human transitions, single-work concurrency, atomic writes, no duplicate execution.
Return structured JSON results and auto-push through the existing GitHub bridge so Prince can read results without user copy/paste.
Keep zero-cost policy and do not expose/read secrets. Only waiting_human for CAPTCHA, payment approval, legal consent, forced human verification.
Add a harmless E2E assigned_to=work test that performs a temporary/local read-only or disposable action and proves todo->in_progress->done plus GitHub result sync.
Update dashboard so Work shows whether execution is queue/local-runner versus ChatGPT Work UI handoff.
Do not break butler/princess adapters, watcher, bridge, dashboard, or existing tracking tasks.
success_criteria: A new assigned_to=work queue task is automatically executed without ChatGPT Work handoff UI.
No user click or result copy/paste is required.
Result appears in royal-queue-sync/done with the same UUID.
Dashboard records Work execution mode and returns to idle after completion.
